simple.meaning: אָסִיף (ʼâçîyph) is a Hebrew object word meaning “gathered , i.e. (abstractly) a gathering in of crops.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 23:16. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אָסִיף (H614) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.short: gathered , i.e. (abstractly) a gathering in of crops
definitions.full: H614. asiph אָסִיף noun [masculine] ingathering, harvest (on formation compare Lag BN 173 Ba NB 136 ) הָאָסִיף חַג Exod 34:22 (J); ׳ה הָאָסִף 23:16 (E) — both Cov't codes. [ אָסֹף ] noun [masculine] what is gathered, store , hence הָאֲסֻמִּים בֵּית store-house , near south gate of temple 1Chr 26:15 (compare 2Chr 25:24 ); 25:17 ׳הָא alone in same sense; compare הַשְּׁעָרִים אֲסֻמֵּי Neh 12:25 .

occurrences.englishText: And the feast of harvest, the first fruits of your labors, which you sow in the field; and the feast of ingathering, at the end of the year, when you gather in your labors out of the field.
“You shall observe the feast of weeks with the first fruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of harvest at the year’s end.
